correctness.rationale: For any p≡1 mod11 and q order11, reduction mod p of cyclotomic resultant |Res(Phi11,sum X^e)| is zero iff a primitive order11 root in the subgroup supports a vanishing short sum. Odd order excludes lengths 1,2. Recomputed independently every 286 three-element and 1001 four-element exponent multiset under AGL(1,11), finding exactly 4 and 12 complete affine orbits, and used symbolic resultant computation to verify all 16 integer norms and their prime factorizations, independently of supplied 10x10 Bareiss checker. The k3 prime set is exactly {23,683}, k4 exactly {23,67,89,419,661,991}; after removing k3 primes obtain m=4 at {67,89,419,661,991}, m≥5 for other admissible p. Finite symbolic orbit exhaustiveness combined with universal splitting lemma, not a cutoff on primes.
